description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the “Ratio” (x-axis) and “minFDE₂₀ (←)” (y-axis), comparing five different methods: TrajICL, Head Tuning, FT, LoRA 16, and LoRA 64. The x-axis, labeled “Ratio,” spans from 0.0 to 1.0 with tick marks at intervals of 0.2, representing a normalized proportion or fraction. The y-axis, labeled “minFDE₂₀ (←),” ranges from 19 to 23 with tick marks at intervals of 1, indicating a metric of trajectory prediction error (lower is better). The TrajICL method (blue line with circle markers, solid line) shows a consistent downward trend, starting at approximately 20.5 at Ratio = 0.0 and decreasing to about 18.3 at Ratio = 1.0. Head Tuning (orange line with circle markers, solid line) begins near 23.0 at Ratio = 0.0, dips slightly to around 22.5 at Ratio = 0.6, then rises slightly to 22.7 at Ratio = 1.0. FT (green line with circle markers, solid line) starts at 22.2, dips to 21.7 at Ratio = 0.2, rises to 22.0 at Ratio = 0.4, then declines to 20.8 at Ratio = 0.6, remains flat until Ratio = 0.8, and rises to 21.0 at Ratio = 1.0. LoRA 16 (red line with circle markers, solid line) begins at 23.0, decreases gradually to 22.2 at Ratio = 0.6, then slightly rises to 22.3 at Ratio = 1.0. LoRA 64 (purple line with circle markers, solid line) starts at 23.0, decreases to 22.2 at Ratio = 0.6, then slightly increases to 22.2 at Ratio = 1.0. All lines are plotted with circular markers at each data point, and the legend is positioned in the upper center of the plot.
